question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Abandonment
solution:
The correct answer is '**Dereliction'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Abandonment"** refers to the act of leaving or deserting something or someone.
 
• **"Dereliction" **is a synonym as it also refers to the act of neglecting or abandoning. (उपेक्षा) 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Dereliction'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Profanity: **Offensive, vulgar, or blasphemous language or behaviour that is disrespectful or obscene. (अश्लीलता, अपमानजनक भाषा)
 
• **Sanctity**: The state or quality of being holy, sacred, or deserving of reverence. (पवित्रता)
 
• **Commencement: **The beginning or start of something; the initiation or inception. (आरंभ)
